messages:
Jordan: evening handoff — leaving in ~30m. Short snapshot of what I saw and next steps.

Jordan: Current incidents: INC-2314 (embed ingest lag, spikes in SQS backlog), INC-2317 (kvcache thrashing on eu-west1), plus a few low-priority 5xxs from regenerator.

Jordan: What I did: restarted the problematic ingest worker group (ingest-workers-v2) at 20:05 UTC, verified consumer lag reduced from ~12k -> ~800 within 10m. Also rolled a config tweak to embedding batch size from 64 -> 48 for that queue.

Jordan: Mitigations in place: autoscaler set to conservative for ingest-workers, `kvcache.eviction_threshold` bumped to 0.78 in eu-west1 for the short term. Canary routing enabled to route 10% of regen traffic to fallback-model-large.

Jordan: Blockers: still seeing occasional regen timeouts when sequence len > 1024, haven't reproduced locally. Also we need a longer-term kv policy — eviction feels like a workaround.

Priya: noted. I can pick up the kv policy tomorrow AM — I'll propose a TTL + size-based tiering. Will open a design doc PR.

Alex: FYI I saw a spike in pod restarts on kvcache-proxy-3 around 19:58 UTC — logs show OOMKilled. I upped memory from 2Gi -> 3Gi on that node pool as temp measure.

Alex: Sharing the pod log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T19:58:12Z ERROR oom-killer invoked, RSS 2.3Gi, limit 2.0Gi
...
```

Marta: Great notes. For INC-2314, do we have a ticket to increase SQS consumer parallelism? If not I can create one and link to the ingest-workers rollout PR.

Jordan: Not yet. Please create. Also add a step to re-evaluate batch size impact on quality (sample a few inputs, compare embeddings distance).

Priya: Will do. I'll also add a perf test in the staging harness to run 1k sample payloads at batch=48 vs 64 and forward results to #eng-ml.

Alex: Ping on PR #4823 (kvcache eviction tweak) — it's ready for quick review. @Priya @Marta can you skim? Small change + unit tests.

Marta: On it, will review in next 20.

oncall-bot: ALERT: INC-2317 persist spike — 3m avg evictions/sec = 14 (threshold 10). Alert triggered at 20:12 UTC.

Jordan: I saw that alert — I increased eviction_threshold as mentioned. If evictions continue > 12 for >10m, fallback routing will switch to eu-west2.

Priya: I'll monitor metrics dashboard and set up a short-lived alert mute so we don't get repeated pager noise while we triage.

Jordan: Next steps (actionable):
- Marta: create SQS consumer parallelism ticket + link to ingest-workers PR (owner: Marta)
- Priya: perf-run for batch sizes + design doc for kv tiering (owner: Priya)
- Alex: merge #4823 after reviews and monitor kvcache-proxy memory usage (owner: Alex)
- Jordan: follow up on regen timeouts reproduction + open INC-2319 if reproducible (owner: Jordan)

Jordan: Handoff notes: nothing needs immediate paging unless eviction rate stays high or consumer lag climbs back above 5k. Otherwise safe to carry to morning.

Marta: ack, I'll create the ticket now and put the PR link in it.

Priya: ack — I'll post perf results to #eng-ml and ping here with summary.

Alex: ack — will watch proxy memory and restart policy.

Jordan: Thanks team. Leaving at 20:35 UTC. :party_parrot:

Marta: Thanks! :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: NOTE: Scheduled job `daily-backup` completed at 20:40 UTC (duration 3m 12s).
